scope: The standing white Solomon’s Temple church in Aizawl, with four crowned corner spires, tall pointed façades, colonnaded porch and immediate podium.

originalReview.notes: The exact 2023 Qualla photograph establishes the white exterior, high freestanding spires, triangular façades, arches, small corner crown details and lower colonnade.

quallaSearch.notes: Verified the exact published Qualla photo against Amishjnu’s first native upload and CC0 dedication. The same view establishes all four tower types, decorative gables and the porch.
